verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a Snyk CLI with `snyk test`, `snyk code test` and CI/CD use, but no cited item mentions JSON, SARIF or any other machine-readable output format. The only reporting reference is the snyk-to-html plugin, which produces human-readable HTML reports and does not show JSON or SARIF emission. Exporting issues to Jira is a tracker integration, not a scan-result format, so the applicable capability is unevidenced.
